prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d start with a **two-bedroom, two-bath rental in Midtown or near downtown**—enough room for everyone, while keeping major sights within an easy drive or walk. A downtown listing highlighted in the search results offers two bedrooms, two baths, a balcony, and a pool; it could be a good fit if the dates and price work. [Browse Nashville family-friendly rentals on Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

If you’d rather have a quieter, more residential stay, look for a whole home in a family-friendly neighborhood and plan on driving or using rideshares. Midtown listings may offer better value and parking; one example in the results is a two-bedroom suite with a full kitchen and free parking. [Browse Midtown family-friendly rentals](https://www.airbnb.com/midtown-nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

Before booking, check the **total price**, bed setup, parking, noise reviews, cancellation terms, and whether the listing has a valid Nashville short-term-rental permit. Nashville requires permits for short-term rentals. [City permit information](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/codes/short-term-rentals)

There isn’t one clear “best” listing without your dates, budget, and preferences—and availability and prices change. Share those, plus whether you’ll have a car and your children’s ages, and I can narrow down what to look for.
